questions.question: Define temporal locality and spatial locality.

rubric.P1: Temporal locality is reuse of the same data soon afterward.
rubric.P2: Spatial locality is accessing nearby addresses close together in time.

questions.canonical: Temporal locality is reuse of the same data soon afterward. Spatial locality is accessing nearby addresses close together in time.
